12347-the-morgesons-a-novel.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Fortunate or not, we were poor. It was not strange that I should marry, said those who knew the step I had taken; but that I should follow that old idyl; and accept the destiny of a garret and a crust with a poet, was incredible! Therefore, being apart from the diversions of society, I had many idle hours.

arxiv-1410-3632.title: Compact Representation of Photosynthesis Dynamics by Rule-based Models (Full Version)
arxiv-1410-3632.creator: L. Brim, J. Nižnan, D. Šafránek
arxiv-1410-3632.description: Abstract Traditional mathematical models of photosynthesis are based on mass action kinetics of light reactions. This approach requires the modeller to enumerate all the possible state combinations of the modelled chemical species. This leads to combinatorial explosion in the number of reactions although the structure of the model could be expressed more compactly.

arxiv-1904-11918.title: Multi-Messenger Physics with the Pierre Auger Observatory
arxiv-1904-11918.creator: The Pierre Auger Collaboration 1
arxiv-1904-11918.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by The Pierre Auger Collaboration 1. An overview of the multi-messenger capabilities of the Pierre Auger Observatory is presented. The techniques and performance of searching for Ultra-High Energy neutrinos, photons and neutrons are described. Some of the most relevant results are reviewed, such as stringent upper bounds that were placed to a flux of diffuse cosmogenic neutrinos and photons, bounds placed on neutrinos emitted from compact binary mergers that were detected by LIGO and Virgo during their first and second observing runs, as well as

arxiv-2005-08694.title: Search for a light pseudoscalar Higgs boson in the boosted \PGm ​ \PGm ​ \PGt ​ \PGt \PGm\PGm\PGt\PGt final state in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2005-08694.description: Abstract A search for a light pseudoscalar Higgs boson ( \Pa ) decaying from the 125 \GeV (or a heavier) scalar Higgs boson ( \PH ) is performed using the 2016 LHC proton-proton collision data at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV , corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 35.9 ​ \fbinv 35.9\fbinv , collected by the CMS experiment.

arxiv-2205-07288.title: Stochastic entropy production for continuous measurements of an open quantum system
arxiv-2205-07288.creator: D. Matos, L. Kantorovich, I.J. Ford
arxiv-2205-07288.description: Abstract We investigate the total stochastic entropy production of a two-level bosonic open quantum system under protocols of time dependent coupling to a harmonic environment. These processes are intended to represent the measurement of a system observable, and consequent selection of an eigenstate, whilst the system is also subjected to thermalising environmental noise.

arxiv-2209-12794.title: Radio interferometric imaging of RS Oph bipolar ejecta for the 2021 nova outburst
arxiv-2209-12794.creator: U. Munari, M. Giroletti, B. Marcote, T. J. O’Brien, P. Veres, J. Yang, D. R. A. Williams, P. Woudt
arxiv-2209-12794.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by U. Munari, M. Giroletti, B. Marcote, T. J. O’Brien, P. Veres, J. Yang, D. R. A. Williams, P. Woudt. The recurrent nova and symbiotic binary RS Oph erupted again in August 2021 for its eighth known outburst. We observed RS Oph 34 days after the outburst at 5 GHz with the European VLBI Network (EVN).

arxiv-2308-10349.title: Electromagnetic radiation at extreme angular velocity
arxiv-2308-10349.creator: Matteo Buzzegoli, Kirill Tuchin
arxiv-2308-10349.description: Abstract We consider a system rotating at extremely high angular velocity, so that its matter is found mostly at the light-cylinder. We posit that it can be described by quantum fields confined to the two-dimensional cylindrical surface rotating about its symmetry axis. We apply this model to study the electromagnetic radiation.

arxiv-2405-02494.title: Chemical disorder effects on the Gilbert damping of FeCo alloys
arxiv-2405-02494.creator: Zhiwei Lu, I. P. Miranda, Simon Streib, Qichen Xu, Rajgowrav Cheenikundil, Manuel Pereiro, Erik Sjöqvist, Olle Eriksson, Anders Bergman, Danny Thonig, Anna Delin
arxiv-2405-02494.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhiwei Lu, I. P. Miranda, Simon Streib, Qichen Xu, Rajgowrav Cheenikundil, Manuel Pereiro, Erik Sjöqvist, Olle Eriksson, Anders Bergman, Danny Thonig, Anna Delin. The impact of the local chemical environment on the Gilbert damping in the binary alloy Fe 100-x Co x is investigated, using computations based on density functional theory.

arxiv-2405-15036.title: Input-driven circuit reconfiguration in critical recurrent neural networks.
arxiv-2405-15036.creator: Marcelo O. Magnasco
arxiv-2405-15036.description: Abstract Changing a circuit dynamically, without actually changing the hardware itself, is called reconfiguration, and is of great importance due to its manifold technological applications. Circuit reconfiguration appears to be a feature of the cerebral cortex, and hence understanding the neuroarchitectural and dynamical features underlying self-reconfiguration may prove key to elucidate brain function.

arxiv-2409-10233.title: Theory of optical spin polarization of axial divacancy and nitrogen-vacancy defects in 4H-SiC
arxiv-2409-10233.creator: Guodong Bian, Gergő Thiering, Ádám Gali
arxiv-2409-10233.description: Abstract The neutral divacancy and the negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy defects in 4H-silicon carbide (SiC) are two of the most prominent candidates for functioning as room-temperature quantum bits (qubits) with telecommunication-wavelength emission. Nonetheless, the pivotal role of electron-phonon coupling in the spin polarization loop is still unrevealed.

arxiv-2506-10666.title: A Quantum Mechanical Pendulum Clock
arxiv-2506-10666.creator: Matteo Brunelli, Mohammad Mehboudi, Nicolas Brunner, Patrick P. Potts
arxiv-2506-10666.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matteo Brunelli, Mohammad Mehboudi, Nicolas Brunner, Patrick P. Potts. We investigate an optomechanical system as a model of an autonomous mechanical pendulum clock in the quantum regime, whose operation relies only on incoherent (thermal) resources. The escapement of the clock, the mechanism that translates oscillatory motion into ticks, is provided by an emitter in the optical cavity and the operation of the clock relies on the existence of a limit cycle.

arxiv-2602-21526.title: 2 2 -DIMENSIONAL UNIT VECTOR FLOWS Thanks: This research was partly funded by NSERC.
arxiv-2602-21526.creator: Hussein Houdrouge, Bobby Miraftab, and Pat Morin
arxiv-2602-21526.description: Abstract We study 2 2 -dimensional unit vector flows on graphs, that is, nowhere-zero flows that assign to each oriented edge a unit vector in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} . We give a new geometric characterization of 𝕊 2 \mathbb{S}^{2} -flows on cubic graphs.

pmc-10572727.title: Healthcare Policies to Eliminate Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTDs) in India: A Roadmap
pmc-10572727.creator: Ajay Chandra, S. D. Sreeganga, Nibedita Rath, Arkalgud Ramaprasad
pmc-10572727.description: The need for systemic healthcare policies to systematically eliminate NTDs globally and in India has been stressed for more than two decades. Yet, the present policies and the research on them do not meet the need. We present an ontological framework, a research roadmap, and a policy brief to address the gap.

pmc-11538544.title: Temporal genomics in Southern Zambia shows rising prevalence of Plasmodium falciparum mutations linked to delayed clearance after artemisinin-lumefantrine treatment
pmc-11538544.creator: Abebe A Fola, Tamaki Kobayashi, Harry Hamapumbu, Michael Musonda, Ben Katowa, Japhet Matoba, Jennifer C Stevenson, Douglas E Norris, Philip E Thuma, Amy Wesolowski, William J Moss, Jonathan J Juliano, Jeffrey A Bailey
pmc-11538544.description: The emergence of antimalarial drug resistance is an impediment to malaria control and elimination in Africa. Analysis of temporal trends in molecular markers of resistance is critical to inform policy makers and guide malaria treatment guidelines. In a low and seasonal transmission region of southern Zambia, we successfully genotyped 85.

pmc-11563188.title: Should Gallbladder Pathologies Be Investigated in Patients With Colon Polyps?
pmc-11563188.creator: Nihan Turhan, Didem Ertorul, Cengiz Duran, Meryem Gözde Kılıç, Taha Yusuf Kuzan, Servan Yaşar, Dilek Yılmaz, Elbrus Zarbaliyev
pmc-11563188.description: BackgroundData regarding the frequency of development of gallbladder pathologies in patients with colon polyps are quite limited and heterogeneous. Hence, this study aimed to investigate whether colon polyps cause an increased risk of developing gallbladder pathologies and the necessity of ultrasonographic screening.

pmc-11728143.title: Parametric Study of Girders with Sinusoidal Corrugated Web
pmc-11728143.creator: Krzysztof Śledziewski, Marcin Górecki, Jakub Gajewski, Michał Rogala
pmc-11728143.description: Recently, steel girders with sinusoidal corrugations have become increasingly popular compared to those with traditional flat webs. This paper presents the second part of the research on the application of corrugated plates with different sinusoidal profiles as webs in girders.

pmc-12540795.title: Experimental investigation of mechanical properties of sustainable silica sand reinforced AA6061 composites subjected to thermomechanical treatment
pmc-12540795.creator: Ramakrishna Vikas Sadanand, Suhas Yeshwant Nayak, Aruna Prabhu
pmc-12540795.description: This study investigates the mechanical performance of sustainable AA6061 matrix composites reinforced with silica sand and subjected to thermomechanical treatments. The objective of this study is to assess silica sand as a cost-effective, eco-friendly alternative to traditional ceramic reinforcements in enhancing strength, hardness, and durability.

pmc-12570554.title: Evaluating the impact of INFINITI mind mapping on stress reduction and academic performance among nursing students: a randomized controlled study in Puducherry
pmc-12570554.creator: Chandrakala Sankarapandian, Jayanthi Kuppunagulu, Renuka Kandaswamy, Noura Almadani, Majed Alamri
pmc-12570554.description: BackgroundNursing students face significant academic stress, which can negatively impact their learning and performance. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of the INFINITI mind mapping technique as a strategy to reduce stress and improve academic performance among first-year B.Sc. Nursing students.MethodsA cluster randomized controlled trial was conducted with 192 first-year B.Sc. Nursing students from selected colleges in Puducherry.

pmc-12624820.title: Co‐Infection With Hepatitis E Virus and SARS‐CoV‐2 in a Lymphoma Patient
pmc-12624820.creator: Yacine Boucetta, Céline Boschi, Erika Peroni, Rodolphe Jean, Erwan Bories, Patrick Borentain, Julien Andreani, Philippe Colson
pmc-12624820.description: Hepatitis E virus (HEV) and SARS‐CoV‐2 are both ubiquitous worldwide. We report here a rare case of HEV and SARS‐CoV‐2 coinfection. HEV and SARS‐CoV‐2 diagnoses were carried out by qPCR. Virus genotyping was performed by analyzing partial or near full‐length genomes obtained by next‐generation sequencing from plasma or nasopharyngeal specimens, respectively.

pmc-12890490.title: Palmitate impairs autophagic degradation via oxidative stress/perilysosomal Ca2+ overload/mTORC1 activation pathway in pancreatic β cells
pmc-12890490.creator: Ha Thu Nguyen, Luong Dai Ly, Thuy Thi Thanh Ngo, Soo Kyung Lee, Carlos Noriega Polo, Subo Lee, Taesic Lee, Seung-Kuy Cha, Xaviera Riani Yasasilka, Kae Won Cho, Myung-Shik Lee, Andreas Wiederkehr, Claes B Wollheim, Kyu-Sang Park
pmc-12890490.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Saturated fatty acids impose lipotoxic stress on pancreatic β cells, leading to β cell failure and diabetes. In this study, we investigate the critical role of organellar Ca2+ disturbance on defective autophagy and β cell lipotoxicity. Palmitate, a saturated fatty acid, induced perilysosomal Ca2+ elevation, sustained mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) activation on the lysosomal membrane, suppression of the lysosomal transient receptor potential mucolipin 1 (TRPML1) channel, and accumulation of undigested autophagosomes in β cells.

pmc-13052105.title: Advances in Crohn's Disease: A Comprehensive Review of Pathophysiology, Diagnosis, and Emerging Therapeutics
pmc-13052105.creator: Yoon‐Kyo An, Robert Gilmore, Graham Radford‐Smith, Jakob Begun
pmc-13052105.description: Crohn's disease (CD) is a chronic inflammatory condition of the bowel with a rising global incidence. Its complex etiology involves genetic susceptibility, environmental factors, and alterations in the gut microbiota, leading to dysregulated immune responses. Prompt diagnosis and personalized treatment are essential to prevent disease flares and complications.

pmc-13477492.title: Emerging non-invasive tools for hair follicle assessment: a narrative review on hyperspectral and terahertz imaging
pmc-13477492.creator: Debalina Bose, Rinky Kapoor, Debashree Das, Debraj Shome, Esmael Ahmed
pmc-13477492.description: Hair loss, though often dismissed as cosmetic, reflects complex vascular, metabolic, structural, and inflammatory changes within the scalp microenvironment. Conventional diagnostic tools such as visual inspection, dermoscopy, trichoscopy, and biopsy remain limited in their ability to determine these evolving processes non-invasively.

pmc-13556425.title: 640. Antidepressants engage estrogen receptor alpha and its intracellular signaling components
pmc-13556425.creator: S Arjmand, M Rezaei, D Sardella, C Cecchi Kaadt, R Rossi, C Vægter, H Müller, J Sahana, M Nielsen, U Simonsen, S Sinning, A Landau, G Wegener, S Joca, C Biojone
pmc-13556425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMajor depressive disorder (MDD) exhibits pronounced sex differences in prevalence, symptom severity, and treatment response, implicating a possible role for sex steroid signaling in mood regulation. Mood disturbances linked to reproductive life stages, such as premenstrual syndrome (PMS), premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), postpartum depression, perimenopausal, and postmenopausal depression, highlight the sensitivity of affective states to fluctuations in ovarian hormones, particularly estrogen. Estrogen receptor alpha (ERα) mediates both classical genomic effects and rapid extranuclear signaling through kinase pathways.
